Job Scope 
High level purpose of function.  
The Production Quality Engineer is responsible for one or more production areas to ensure across the organization that Quality Assurance principles are strictly adhered to. This involves working closely with manufacturing and engineering to support improvement processes to ensure a flawless transition into manufacturing. Specifically, to take part in the specific processes, support in their performance and results, providing technical expertise and guidance to the team to reach targets assigned. 

Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)  
Lead quality assurance activities in production ensure that production/product quality specifications are met.  
Lead and train quality team members and operations on quality standards and procedures.  
Perform onboarding and attendance timesheets validation related to led team members.  
Lead problem solving and root cause analysis activities in relation to deviations and quality issues, e.g., 8D and non-conformity investigations.  
Contribute to FMEA reviews.  
Lead launch activities to ensure the deliverables of different projects.  
Collaborate cross-functionally on shopfloor to improve manufacturing processes and implements solutions.  
Monitor NCM processes and ensure closing of actions in defined time.  
Update and monitor the Quality Control plans for each process operation.  
Define and improve Work instructions and procedures for Quality related activities.  
Monitor quality procedures, quality KPI's, evaluate performance and make improvement proposals, i.e., Process capability: SPC and Cpk.  
Define and monitor MSA activities.  
Develop, implement, and audit standard instructions.
Implement and audit standard procedures.  
Plan and perform product / process audits and lead action plan to comply with customer's requirements and IATF 16949 and VDA.  
Contribute/lead scrap reduction action plan and improvements implementation.  

 Accountability/Authorization 
​​Budget responsibility:​ ​No​ 
​​Direct reports:​ ​No​ 
Work Environment Responsibility: No 

All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace. 

Requirements 
Educational background and previous experience required for the role. 
Qualifications and experience  
Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience 
Experience of quality work in relevant industries such as, e.g. Li-ion materials, Pharmaceutical, Food and Paper industries, or automotive industries. 
Experience with Statistical Process Control (SPC), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Control Plan (CP), Lean, Six Sigma, Quality troubleshooting tools and problem-solving methodology.   

Specific skills & Knowledge 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.  
 Knowledge in Quality Management Systems (QMS), such as, ISO 9001, IATF16949, and Total Quality Management (TQM) principles.   
Project management skills and a successful track record of leading quality projects in a manufacturing or similar environment.

Intermodulation Products AB is a pioneering company developing advanced test and measurement equipment for the quantum technology sector. As we continue to expand the reach of our flagship Presto platform, we are looking for a highly technical and outgoing Quantum Application Engineer to join our team in Stockholm.
In this role, you will be the crucial link between our technology and the global physics community. Your primary focus will be helping existing and potential customers understand how Presto can solve their most complex measurement needs across superconducting circuits, quantum sensing, computing, and communication. You will own and run live demonstrations using our in-house superconducting qubit setup, represent us at scientific conferences, and provide critical technical support for both sales and existing users. You will also travel to customer laboratories, spending time with researchers to deeply understand their experimental workflows and pain points, and bring those insights directly back to our development team. This role is perfect for a physicist who loves being hands-on with technology but finds it equally fun and energizing to interact with people.
Responsibilities
Help existing and potential customers understand how the Presto platform solves specific measurement challenges in quantum tech and RF.
Own, maintain, and present live technical demonstrations using our superconducting qubit setup.
Represent the company at international scientific conferences, presenting our products at the booth and engaging with fellow physicists.
Partner with the sales team to provide technical pre-sales support and system configuration advice.
Assist customers with high-level technical support questions and troubleshooting.
Travel to customer labs to spend time on-site, understanding their measurement pain points and workflows.
Act as the voice of the customer, forwarding field knowledge and feature requests to our internal development team.

Requirements
PhD (preferred) or MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Quantum Engineering, or a highly related field.
Strong background in experimental physics with hands-on knowledge of microwave and low-temperature measurements.
A highly technical mindset coupled with a strong willingness and enthusiasm to engage, network, and interact with fellow physicists.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex measurement concepts clearly.
Willingness and ability to travel to scientific conferences and customer laboratories globally.
Good written and spoken English.

Meritorious Qualifications: You do not need to have experience in all of the areas below. Experience in one or more is considered an advantage:
Experience with Python programming, specifically for data acquisition, instrument control, and data analysis.
Previous experience in technical sales, field application engineering, or customer-facing scientific support.
Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting dilution refrigerators or other cryogenic systems.
Practical experience working directly with superconducting qubits or similar solid-state quantum devices.
Familiarity with RF/microwave instrumentation (e.g., AWGs, VNAs, digitizers, spectrum analyzers).
Experience with experimental control software and quantum measurement frameworks (e.g., QCoDeS, Labber, Qiskit Experiments).
Basic understanding of FPGA-based signal processing.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced Scrum Master for a new development project focused on automotive interior and seat development. The role is responsible for leading and supporting a cross-functional development team, maintaining alignment with project objectives, and driving planning, execution, and delivery in accordance with agile principles.
The Scrum Master will facilitate effective ways of working, coordinate team activities and milestones, and promote collaboration among engineering teams, project management, and other stakeholders. The assignment also includes financial oversight, risk and dependency management, status reporting, and continuous improvement of the team and its development processes.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and support a cross-functional development team throughout project planning, execution, follow-up, and delivery.
Facilitate Scrum practices and other agile ways of working while ensuring alignment with project goals, delivery plans, and milestones.
Coordinate team activities and promote effective collaboration across engineering disciplines and stakeholder groups.
Monitor and report the project's financial position, including investments, material expenditure, and development costs.
Provide regular progress, delivery, and financial status updates to project management.
Identify and manage project risks, dependencies, obstacles, and delivery constraints.
Build stakeholder alignment through structured communication, facilitation, and negotiation.
Drive continuous improvement within the team and across the broader product development process.
Support timely decision-making while maintaining focus on project targets and financial performance.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Agile and Scrum: Practical experience applying agile principles and facilitating Scrum-based development.
Project management: Experience with project planning, execution, delivery coordination, follow-up, and milestone management.
Cross-functional delivery: Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary development teams.
Financial management: Experience monitoring budgets, investments, material costs, development costs, and overall project financials.
Risk and dependency management: Ability to identify, track, escalate, and resolve risks, dependencies, and delivery obstacles.
Stakeholder management: Experience facilitating alignment and coordinating decisions across multiple functions and organizational levels.

Qualifications & Experience
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline, is required. Candidates must have at least four years of experience as a Project Leader, Project Manager, Scrum Master, or in a comparable leadership role. The role requires experience in agile development environments, cross-functional team coordination, project planning and follow-up, financial reporting, facilitation, and stakeholder management. Professional spoken and written English is required.
Experience in automotive product development, particularly interior systems or seat development, is advantageous. Additional merits include a background in mechanical engineering and product development, experience working in large international organizations, and professional spoken and written Swedish.

2MNordic is looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer for a long-term client assignment in Malmö. You will build complex web interfaces where performance, reliability, accessibility and privacy are central to the user experience.

development, testing and production. The role suits someone who can turn broad requirements into practical solutions, challenge assumptions and adapt as priorities evolve.

• Develop and maintain web applications using React, TypeScript and modern CSS.

maintained in production.

and memory management.

• Proven ability to diagnose issues across devices, slow networks and large datasets.

with real data.
• Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, Docker and GitHub workflows.
• The ability to investigate dependencies beyond their documentation when needed.

Operating and monitoring automated and semi-automated production processes

Manufacturing and assembling solar cells and solar panels throughout different stages of production

Working with small components that require precision and attention to detail

Performing quality checks and documenting production results

Monitoring processes and reporting deviations

Following work instructions, procedures and safety routines

Collaborating with colleagues to ensure an efficient production flow

Supporting continuous improvements within the production team

The role requires you to work both independently and as part of a team while taking ownership of your responsibilities following your training period.

Fluency in English, both written and spoken
